Type: three-light linear pendant chandelier
Use: light over a dining table or island; dining room, kitchen
Style: industrial, farmhouse, rustic
Materials: pipe-style metal frame in gunmetal finish, clear glass drum shades
Colors: dark gunmetal black, clear glass
Shape: horizontal pipe bar on two downrods, three sockets with wide short clear drum shades, exposed bulbs, long and linear, medium visual weight
Feel: utilitarian, warm, open
Goes with: reclaimed wood tables, white or brick walls, black metal accents; industrial or farmhouse dining rooms
